title: Quiz: Hooks and Extensions
limitations: Generated from concept pages; not yet reviewed by Luis.
Content may drift from source; verify against current main.

questions.scenario: A before-hook returns HookAction.BLOCK on a TOOL_CALL_REQUESTED event. What happens?
options: The event is not forwarded to the inner EventSink
questions.explanation: BLOCK prevents the event from reaching the inner sink, but after-hooks still run.

questions.scenario: A hook handler raises an exception. What happens to the event pipeline?
options: The exception is caught and logged; the event is forwarded
questions.explanation: Error isolation ensures broken hooks never crash the pipeline.

questions.scenario: You set trusted=False on HookRegistry. What happens when you try to register a hook?
options: The hook is registered but never fires
questions.explanation: Untrusted workspaces disable all hook registration (all-or-nothing trust).

questions.scenario: Which built-in hook blocks tool calls targeting .env files?
questions.explanation: protected_paths_hook checks path arguments against a pattern list.
HookRegistry wraps any EventSink, making it composable with the existing event infrastructure.
